lines.text: Sixty seconds from clone to your first gated claim.
One repo. Python three-eleven, standard library only. Clone it, run the demo — nothing to install.
A session opens. Identity is signed. The meter starts. Eight steps run — every call metered, every event attested.
The agent claims tests passed. The gate checks the evidence — and stops it cold. Stale. Eight forty-seven seconds old.
The recovery is machine-readable — re-run the tests. The agent does. Same claim, fresh evidence: admit.
Your whole integration is five lines. Wrap the tool calls. Gate the claim. No wrappers to maintain — the gate does the rest.
Every decision lands in a tamper-evident chain. Seventeen events, one hash chain — verifiable offline, forever.
Sixty seconds. Your first gated claim. var-runtime — open source. Proof-or-Stop.
